question: If in a certain code, UNSURE is written as ELGEHU, which of the following options will be written as YNYHM in the same code?
solution:
The alphabet and their positions as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

The logic here is:

For, UNSURE is written as ELGEHU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c74636f3cc80c5dcb2f226e55a5f31425ceb28334b618401a5d22119fb21d14.png] 

Similarly, for ALARM it is written as YNYHM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8cd1d6dac5493a3b7d058cef09d86991b78320e28595f95fd10dac8357710c5.png] 

Thus, the word **ALARM** is written as YNYHM.

 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
